summary: agent-api endpoints and SMTP configuration from agents/README.md (delta over proposals 01-02).

ops.text: agent-api is available at `http://localhost:8090` with `/health`, `/chat`, `/jobs` and `/invoke/{job_name}`.
chatui proxies to agent-api, so day-to-day the API should not need to be called directly.
ops.quote: `chatui` proxies to it for you, so day to day you shouldn't need to call it directly

ops.text: `SMTP_PORT` defaults to 587 (465 with `SMTP_SSL=true`), and `SMTP_STARTTLS` defaults to true unless SSL is used.
With `SMTP_HOST` unset the email tools return `{"sent": false, "skipped": ...}` and jobs are unaffected.
ops.quote: With `SMTP_HOST` unset the tools return `{"sent": false, "skipped": ...}` and jobs are unaffected

ops.text: `notify_on_task_creation = 0` on the household profile suppresses all three email tools.
ops.quote: `notify_on_task_creation = 0` on the profile suppresses all three

ops.text: Each of the three email tools sends one multipart (plain-text + HTML) message to the household Profile address.
ops.quote: send one multipart (plain-text + HTML) message to the household Profile address
